messages.author: 55db3f412c1e7e5d
messages.subject: Plots. Names in Russian.
parts:
Hello all! I'm a new one to this world of the ggplot users but have already found this package as the most useful one for my needs. Given the fact that I'm visualizing data that contains some names in Russian I encountered kind of a problem of saving plots in PDF files. The problem is that I'm using pdf() function that gives me ...... instead of names in Russian. I understand that the problem is in fonts installed, but still haven't solved the issue.
If anyone has a good and easy way to solve this conundrum I'd greatly appreciate if you share.

messages.author: 55db3f412c1e7e5d
messages.subject: Re: Plots. Names in Russian.
parts:
Installed. When use family = "CM Roman Cyrillic" the output says that "no font could be found for family "CM Roman Cyrillic". Example of script below.

theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = .5, size = 5, colour = "black"),
...
legend.text = element_text(size = 5, family = "CM Roman Cyrillic"),
...
